top_news.title: Sympathetic Framing: Evaluating AI Alignment across Sociodemographic Groups
top_news.dek: Researchers evaluated how well seven LLMs align with human emotional perception regarding news headlines about political and geopolitical conflicts.
top_news.brief: The study compared responses from 3,011 UK participants against seven LLMs to determine if models accurately identify sympathy-evoking language in news. The findings highlight the challenges of AI alignment in subjective areas like emotional nuance and political framing.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing alignment scores between human participants and various LLMs

top_news.title: Stream - Rotate Stream broadcast keys for live inputs
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Stream now supports rotating broadcast keys for live inputs without changing identifiers.
top_news.brief: Developers can now rotate broadcast credentials for Stream live inputs via the API. This update allows for immediate revocation of compromised keys or routine security refreshes without needing to update the live input identifier in existing broadcast configurations.

top_news.title: NVIDIA Video Codec SDK 13.1: Zero-Copy Transcode, AV1 B-Frames, and Frame-Accurate Seek
top_news.dek: NVIDIA Video Codec SDK 13.1 introduces zero-copy transcoding, AV1 B-frame support, and frame-accurate seeking for GPU-accelerated pipelines.
top_news.brief: The latest SDK update optimizes video processing by enabling zero-copy transcoding, which reduces latency and CPU overhead. It also adds support for AV1 B-frames to improve compression efficiency and introduces frame-accurate seeking capabilities for more precise video manipulation in professional workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing NVIDIA GPU video engine architecture and data flow

top_news.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
top_news.dek: Snapchat has updated its Spotlight recommendation algorithm to exclude fully AI-generated content from creator rewards.
top_news.brief: Snapchat is prioritizing human-made content by adjusting its recommendation systems to disqualify fully AI-generated videos from its Spotlight reward program. The platform aims to maintain authenticity and ensure that creator payouts are directed toward original, human-produced media.

primary.title: Stream - Rotate Stream broadcast keys for live inputs
primary.summary: You can now rotate the broadcast credentials for a Stream live input without changing the live input identifier. Use key rotation when live input credentials may have been shared with the wrong audience, exposed in client code or a screenshare, or need to be refreshed as part of your security process. Rotating keys revokes the old credentials, disconnects broadcasts using stale credentials, and returns refreshed credentials in the API response. To rotate keys for a live input, make a POST request to the rotate_keys endpoint: curl --request POST \ https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{
